links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and specificity for ACS in chest pain triage, LLMs versus human experts
links.effect: MediGuide-14B accuracy 87.52% and specificity 78.63%, versus human experts 86.37% accuracy and 89.26% specificity. Accuracy was comparable, but specificity was lower than the experts'.
links.quote: MediGuide-14B demonstrated the highest accuracy (87.52%) and specificity (78.63%), comparable to human experts (86.37% accuracy, 89.26% specificity).

screen.reason: Evaluated the diagnostic performance of LLMs (including MediGuide-14B) on a retrospective dataset of 11,428 emergency department chest pain patients compared to human experts without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
